in_marathi.name: Parvat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parvat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parvat is a name derived from the Sanskrit word parvata, meaning mountain. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture and carries the symbolism of strength, beauty, and calmness.
